request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v for administration on behalf of the vendor TxPipe.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe: Open API Layer for Cardano's dApp Protocols, described as an open standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols with developer and AI-agent support.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide a standard open-source interface for Cardano protocols, including documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live RPC endpoints.
The proposal states that Catalyst Fund 14 has already put Tx3's developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal claims there is currently no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and rebuild understanding independently.
The proposal says it will fund 12 additional protocol onboardings, at 3 per quarter, with developer and agent coverage.
The proposal claims the work aligns with Intersect budget Pillar 2 on Adoption & Utility and Pillar 4 on Community & Ecosystem Growth.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit at the time of submission, either alone or in aggregate.
The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

The proposal states treasury funds will be administered through Intersect-managed smart contracts with milestone-based disbursement controls, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month Tx3 work program administered by Intersect, centered on expanding an open protocol interface layer, adding AI-agent-facing infrastructure, onboarding 12 more protocols, and using Intersect/Sundae Labs treasury management contracts with oversight and dashboard reporting.
